*Application VM Memory Baseline*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

First JT 15 stops/removes memory pressure and resets the POC scenarios. Only after that job succeeds, JT 35 restores configured RAM above 16 GiB to the approved 16 GiB baseline.

*Scenario:* `reset-memory`
*Environment:* `poc`
*Execution:* `AAP JT 15 → AAP JT 35`

:warning: *Restoring RAM above baseline powers the application VM off and on. Temporary application downtime is expected. Use only after the demo.*

JT 35 does not stop pressure itself. It returns without resizing when RAM is at or below baseline; below-baseline results require manual review.

_Next → Stop pressure with JT 15, then restore RAM with JT 35_
